resources.string: Backups may contain personal data. Conversations, settings and MCP require encryption. Codex logins and image API keys are never included.
Create an encrypted package of all six categories.
Data, settings and MCP require a password. The encrypted ZIP payload limit is %1$d MiB.
Open a category package or an official Eta JSON backup.
Legacy JSON verified. Select Data to restore it.
Integrity checked. Select the categories to restore.
No API key is backed up. The model can be restored only to a locally authorized connection at the same endpoint.
Use at least 8 characters. Keep the password safe; Eta cannot recover it.
Selected: %1$s. Data replaces conversations, non-Codex providers and memory. Existing Skill and subagent files are not overwritten; imported MCP servers start disabled.
Wait for this operation to finish. It cannot be cancelled here.
Image connection not changed. To use it, set up and authorize the endpoint in Image Generation.
The backup operation failed. Check the file or try again.
The backup exceeds the supported size limit.
Incorrect password or damaged encrypted backup.
The selected categories conflict with existing items. No existing item is overwritten by the conflict.
Stop running Agent tasks and wait for conversation saves before restoring.
Data was committed, but cleanup or reload failed. Check the current data before retrying.
The restore failed and some changes could not be undone. Check current data and the Skills recovery page.
